checks.name: Review 10 content hierarchy, six Quick Logs and opt-in decorative controls
Both room floors use four desktop columns, distinct state labels, immediate save and persistent Undo
Combo starts empty, supports Space, focuses missing recipient, preserves review choices and saves only selected tasks
Borrow validates exactly 13 ASCII digits without truncation; return retains borrower and Undo restores status
Manual draft survives centered task selection, suggestions, date changes and CSS/QuickLiquid switching
Second Quick Log page keeps plug/USB inventory and phone entry usable without changing the layout
Selected date filters both daily counts and agenda instead of repeating the previous date
Sampled semantic status and primary tint colors maintain text contrast in both themes
Explicit app dark theme, reduced motion, solid surfaces and forced colors remain functional
Mobile layouts 375/390/430/768 keep controls, date inputs and room sheets inside the viewport
Keyboard Escape restores focus, selected person uses ID and original display label

limitations: Chromium touch emulation is not physical Safari/iPhone or Android UAT
